features.description: Conditional pmf = w * pf + (1 - w) * C1 per stat (linear opinion pool; stays a coherent pmf). limitations: Data defect: the projection-data market_snapshots stage archived no T-60 (or any pregame) boards after the 2026-11-06 tips; games of 2026-11-07..13 have forecasts and outcomes but no market reference. The capture-worker boards on data-archive were not read.

One month of 2026-27 regular season (176 games with outcomes, 2026-10-20..2026-11-13); T-60 player-prop quotes exist for 118 games and only 31 TEST games, so every challenger-vs-market row is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE regardless of its point estimate.

The pf label covered 28 distinct code commits over the window (pf-1.2.1 on the first slates, then pf-1.3.0); 'the frozen incumbent' is the version stream that was live at each freeze, not one fixed binary.

Spread and total probabilities from the pf team-points forecasts use a normal approximation with the archived rho (the owner's own note calls them approximate); team totals use the archived pmf exactly.
The pf team-points forecasts under-forecast 2026-27 scoring (team points bias in design.accuracy.game_means), which by itself explains part of the total / team-total gap to the market.
C1 is a re-implementation of the 0.1 procedure on 2026-27 data with the frozen pf roster as its population; it is not the 0.1 code path run unchanged (0.1 hard-codes 2025-26 inputs).

During development the author looked at TEST CRPS for a few pool weights before the inner-validation selection rule was fixed in code; the rule itself never reads TEST, but this is disclosed as a mild garden-of-forking-paths risk.
Implicit ACTIVE roster rows in the availability archive are not used (PR #104 found their timestamps can precede the roster evidence); only explicit official-report rows are.
Outcomes for 181 box-score rows of players absent from the frozen roster cannot be assigned a team and are excluded from challenger history (not from scoring).
No fees, no execution, no profitability claim; yes-ask rows are a pessimistic price read as a probability, not an executable edge measure.

evidence_sufficiency.challenger_vs_incumbent: 88 TEST games, two cohorts of about one week each; one month of season
evidence_sufficiency.challenger_vs_market: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: only 31 TEST games carry T-60 player-prop quotes and all fall in cohort 1; the projection-data market archive has no T-60 boards for games after 2026-11-06, so no challenger-vs-market row can replicate in cohort 2
evidence_sufficiency.incumbent_vs_market: SUFFICIENT for a direction on points/rebounds/assists/PRA ladders, spreads and team totals (118 games with T-60 quotes, all market rows NOT_IMPROVED or INCONCLUSIVE for the incumbent); the incumbent never significantly beats the mid

verdict.reason: The frozen production model pf is clearly better than the frozen shadow baseline but worse than the Kalshi T-60 mid on player-prop ladders over 118 games; its disagreements with the market carry no outcome information. The 0.2 pool improves pf on assists CRPS (validated) and is neutral elsewhere; it does not beat the market and is research-only.
verdict.rule: Fixed in code: VALIDATED_IMPROVEMENT only if C2 is validated against the frozen pf incumbent (CRPS and two-sided ladder Brier) AND against the Kalshi T-60 mid in all four prop families; any validated row vs pf with none worse reads IMPROVED_NOT_VALIDATED.
